# commercetools_integration_layer_idp_login (Resource)

Customer login on the Commerce Integration Layer through an external OpenID Connect identity provider. A customer who signs in there gets a Commerce Integration Layer session, matched to a commercetools Customer by `match_strategy`.

A Project has at most one identity provider, so define this resource once per Project. Destroying it disables the login.

The API never returns the client secret. Terraform keeps the configured value in state and cannot detect that it was changed outside of Terraform. After an import, the secret stays as stored until `client_secret` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "idp_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "commercetools_integration_layer_idp_login" "login" {
  issuer              = "https://login.example.com"
  token_endpoint      = "https://login.example.com/oauth2/token"
  revocation_endpoint = "https://login.example.com/oauth2/revoke"
  jwks_uri            = "https://login.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json"
  client_id           = "storefront"
  client_secret       = var.idp_client_secret
  redirect_uri        = "https://shop.example.com/auth/callback"
  match_strategy      = "email"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) Client ID of the application registered with the identity provider.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer of the identity provider's tokens, as in their `iss` claim.
- `jwks_uri` (String) Where the identity provider publishes the keys its tokens are signed with.
- `match_strategy` (String) How a signed-in customer is matched to a commercetools Customer: `externalId` by the `external_id` claim, `email` by the email address.
- `redirect_uri` (String) Redirect URI registered with the identity provider.
- `revocation_endpoint` (String) The identity provider's token revocation endpoint.
- `token_endpoint` (String) The identity provider's token endpoint.

### Optional

- `authorization_endpoint` (String) The identity provider's authorization endpoint, for a login started by the Commerce Integration Layer.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of that application. Required when the login is first created. Leave it out afterwards to keep the stored secret.
- `email_claim` (String) Token claim the Customer's email address is read from. Defaults to `email`.
- `external_id_claim` (String) Token claim the Customer's external ID is read from. Defaults to `sub`.
- `first_name_claim` (String) Token claim the Customer's first name is read from. Defaults to `given_name`.
- `last_name_claim` (String) Token claim the Customer's last name is read from. Defaults to `family_name`.
- `phone_claim` (String) Token claim the Customer's phone number is read from. Defaults to `phone_number`.

### Read-Only

- `has_client_secret` (Boolean) Whether the Commerce Integration Layer holds a client secret.
- `id` (String) The key of the Project the login belongs to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The IdP login is a singleton per Project, so it is imported using the
# Project key.
#
# The client secret is not returned by the API. After an import the stored
# secret is kept until client_secret is set and applied.
terraform import commercetools_integration_layer_idp_login.login my-project-key
```
